posts.title: Invariant culture string interpolation with [InterpolatedStringHandler]
posts.description: In this post I show how you can use a custom [InterpolatedStringHandler] to ensure string interpolation formats values using the invariant culture

posts.title: Understanding Lazy thread safety modes
posts.description: In this post I look at how the different `LazyThreadSafetyMode` values work with `Lazy `, and how exceptions are handled for each mode

posts.title: An introduction to Compact Binary Object Representation (CBOR) in .NET
posts.description: In this post I introduce CBOR as a JSON alternative, and show how to use the System.Formats.Cbor NuGet package to read and write CBOR encoded data
